Trimmer MP3 — Initial Release (v1.0.0)

- Instantly trim and export audio (MP3, WAV, AAC, M4A) using simple text instructions, no complex software required.
- Seamless cloud processing: upload files up to 200MB, edit, and download finished clips in seconds.
- Smart connection setup: Uses existing NEMO_TOKEN or fetches a temporary token automatically for new users.
- Handles multiple workflows including trimming silence/dead air, batch processing, and iterative edits—all tracked per session.
- Exports final edits as MP4 (1080p default) for easy sharing and compatibility.
- Robust error handling and clear prompts keep users informed throughout the process.
